calculators.title_native: 香港薪俸稅及個人入息課稅計算機
calculators.title_en: Hong Kong Salaries Tax & Personal Assessment Calculator
calculators.description_native: 計算香港薪俸稅與個人入息課稅，涵蓋漸進稅率（2%-17%）與兩級標準稅率（15%/16%）比較、單身/已婚免稅額、子女及供養父母免稅額、強積金（MPF）、自願醫保（VHIS）及年金扣稅項目。

inputs.name: annual_income
inputs.label_native: 每年總薪金及津貼收入 (HKD)

inputs.name: marital_status
inputs.label_native: 婚姻狀況與計稅方式
options: single (單身 / 未婚 / 離異)

inputs.name: num_children
inputs.label_native: 供養未成年或全日制就讀子女數目

inputs.name: num_dependent_parents_55_59
inputs.label_native: 供養 55 至 59 歲父母/祖父母人數

inputs.name: num_dependent_parents_60_plus
inputs.label_native: 供養 60 歲或以上父母/祖父母人數

inputs.name: co_residence_parents
inputs.label_native: 是否與供養父母/祖父母全年同住
options: no (不同住，但每年提供不少於 HK$12,000 生活費)

inputs.name: mpf_mandatory
inputs.label_native: 每年強積金強制性供款扣除額 (最高 HK$18,000)

inputs.name: vhis_premiums
inputs.label_native: 自願醫保 (VHIS) 每年已繳保費 (每名受保人最高 HK$8,000)

inputs.name: qdta_tvc
inputs.label_native: 合資格延期年金 (QDTA) 及強積金自願性供款 (TVC) (最高 HK$60,000)

inputs.name: home_loan_interest
inputs.label_native: 居所貸款利息扣除額 (每年最高 HK$100,000)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Net Chargeable Income (應課稅入息實額) = Total Income - Allowances - Deductions.
2. Deductions include Mandatory MPF (capped at HK$18,000/year), VHIS Premiums (capped at HK$8,000 per insured person), QDTA/TVC combined (capped at HK$60,000), Self-Education (capped at HK$100,000), and Home Loan Interest (capped at HK$100,000).
3. Progressive Rates: First HK$50k @ 2%, Next HK$50k @ 6%, Next HK$50k @ 10%, Next HK$50k @ 14%, Remainder @ 17%.
4. Standard Tax Rates (Two-tiered): 15% on net income up to HK$5,000,000; 16% on income exceeding HK$5,000,000.
5. Tax Payable is the lower of Progressive Tax calculation and Standard Rate Tax calculation, less any annual government statutory tax reduction (e.g. 100% capped at HK$3,000).

calculators.title_native: 香港物業印花稅及按揭首期計算機
calculators.title_en: Hong Kong Property Stamp Duty & Mortgage Calculator
search_terms_native: 從價印花稅 AVD 稅額
calculators.description_native: 計算香港住宅物業從價印花稅 (AVD Scale 2 稅率)、按揭貸款成數 (LTV 上限 70%)、首期及按揭每月供款金額。

inputs.name: property_value
inputs.label_native: 物業買賣成交價 (HKD)

inputs.name: buyer_status
inputs.label_native: 買家身分與物業類別
options: hkpr_first_time (香港永久居民 - 首次置業或換樓)
non_hkpr_or_company (非香港永久居民或公司名義購買)

inputs.name: mortgage_tenure_years
inputs.label_native: 按揭貸款年期 (年，最多 30 年)

inputs.name: interest_rate
inputs.label_native: 按揭實際年利率 (%)

inputs.name: ltv_percentage
inputs.label_native: 按揭貸款成數 LTV (%)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Ad Valorem Stamp Duty (AVD Scale 2 Rates): 
   - Up to HK$3,000,000: HK$100
   - HK$3,000,001 to HK$3,528,240: HK$100 + 10% of excess over HK$3M
   - HK$3,528,241 to HK$4,500,000: 1.50%
   - HK$4,500,001 to HK$5,315,630: HK$67,500 + 10% of excess over HK$4.5M
   - HK$5,315,631 to HK$7,200,000: 2.25%
   - HK$7,200,001 to HK$9,607,060: HK$162,000 + 10% of excess over HK$7.2M
   - HK$9,607,061 to HK$20,000,000: 3.75%
   - Over HK$20,000,000: 4.25% (with smooth transition bracket up to HK$21,739,130).
2. Mortgage Amount = Property Value × LTV%.
3. Down Payment (首期) = Property Value - Mortgage Amount.
4. Total Cash Required = Down Payment + Stamp Duty + Legal Fees (~0.5%) + Agency Commission (1%).
5. Monthly Payment = P × [ r(1+r)^n ] / [ (1+r)^n - 1 ], where P = Mortgage Amount, r = monthly interest rate, n = tenure in months.

calculators.title_native: 香港強積金 MPF 供款及僱主僱員扣減計算機
calculators.title_en: Hong Kong MPF Mandatory Provident Fund Contribution Calculator
search_terms_native: 最高有關入息上限 MPF
calculators.description_native: 根據香港《強制性公積金計劃條例》，計算僱員、自僱人士 (SEP) 與僱主之 5% 強制性供款金額（最低入息 HK$7,100 及最高入息上限 HK$30,000）。

inputs.name: employment_type
inputs.label_native: 身份類別
options: regular_employee (一般全職 / 兼職僱員)

inputs.name: monthly_income
inputs.label_native: 每月有關入息 (HKD)

inputs.name: tvc_contribution
inputs.label_native: 每月自願性強積金供款 (TVC / 額外供款) (HKD)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Mandatory Provident Fund Thresholds: Minimum Relevant Income = HK$7,100/month; Maximum Relevant Income = HK$30,000/month.
2. Employee Contribution Rate = 5% of monthly relevant income (0% if monthly income < HK$7,100; capped at HK$1,500/month if income > HK$30,000).
3. Employer Contribution Rate = 5% of monthly relevant income (5% regardless of min income limit; capped at HK$1,500/month if income > HK$30,000).
4. Self-Employed Persons (SEP): Mandatory 5% of income, HK$0 if income < HK$7,100, capped at HK$1,500/month if income > HK$30,000.
5. Net Monthly Salary = Monthly Income - Employee Mandatory MPF Contribution.

calculators.title_native: 香港公司及獨資業務利得稅計算機 (兩級制稅率)
calculators.title_en: Hong Kong Profits Tax Calculator (Two-Tiered Rates)
calculators.description_native: 計算香港法團 (Corporation) 與非法團業務 (Sole Proprietorship) 於兩級制利得稅率 (8.25%/16.5% 或 7.5%/15%) 下的應繳稅額及扣稅優惠。

inputs.name: entity_type
inputs.label_native: 業務實體種類
options: corporation (有限公司 / 法團 - Corporations)
unincorporated (獨資 / 合夥 / 非法團 - Unincorporated Businesses)

inputs.name: gross_revenue
inputs.label_native: 每年營業收入總額 (HKD)

inputs.name: allowable_expenses
inputs.label_native: 合資格業務開支及資本折舊免稅額 (HKD)

inputs.name: two_tier_eligible
inputs.label_native: 是否符合兩級制利得稅資格 (關連企業中僅限一家申報)
options: yes (符合兩級制優惠稅率資格)
no (不符合，按標準單一稅率計算)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Assessable Profits (應評稅利潤) = Gross Revenue - Allowable Expenses.
2. Two-Tiered Tax Rates for Corporations:
   - Profits up to HK$2,000,000 @ 8.25%
   - Profits exceeding HK$2,000,000 @ 16.5%
3. Two-Tiered Tax Rates for Unincorporated Businesses:
   - Profits up to HK$2,000,000 @ 7.5%
   - Profits exceeding HK$2,000,000 @ 15.0%
4. Standard Single Rate (if not eligible for two-tiered): 16.5% for Corporations; 15.0% for Unincorporated Businesses.
5. Statutory Concession Deduction: Subtract government annual tax reduction (e.g. 100% capped at HK$3,000).
6. Final Profits Tax Payable = Max(0, Calculated Tax - Tax Reduction).

calculators.title_native: 香港遣散費及長期服務金計算機 (強積金對沖)
calculators.title_en: Hong Kong Severance Payment & Long Service Payment Calculator
search_terms_native: 遣散費計算機 香港
calculators.description_native: 根據香港《僱傭條例》（第57章），計算解僱遣散費 (SP) 或長期服務金 (LSP)，採納最新工資上限 HK$22,500 與總額上限 HK$390,000，並試算強積金對沖金額。

inputs.name: payment_type
inputs.label_native: 補償金類別
options: severance_payment (遣散費 - 因裁員/停工解僱)
long_service_payment (長期服務金 - 服務滿5年解僱/退休/健康原因離職)

inputs.name: last_month_wage
inputs.label_native: 離職前最後一個月完整工資 (HKD)

inputs.name: years_of_service
inputs.label_native: 服務年資 (年，可包含小數代表不完整月份)

inputs.name: employer_mpf_accrued
inputs.label_native: 僱主供款所累積的強積金權益金額 (HKD)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Capped Monthly Wage = Min(Last Month Wage, HK$22,500).
2. Gross Statutory Payment (法定應得款額) = Capped Monthly Wage × (2 / 3) × Years of Service.
3. Maximum Statutory Cap: Total payment is capped at HK$390,000.
4. MPF Offsetting (強積金對沖金額): Employer can offset the statutory payment using the accrued benefits derived from employer's mandatory/voluntary MPF contributions.
5. Net Payable by Employer = Max(0, Statutory Payment - Employer MPF Accrued Benefits).
6. Un-offset Remainder paid to employee from MPF accrued benefits.
